File 7
Listening 1
Emma
Are you busy, Robert?
Robert
No. Why?
Emma
Well, I’m going to write about my friends on my website,
and I want to ask you some questions about your hobbies
and interests. Is that OK?
Robert
Sure.
Emma
Great. OK. So, what do you like doing in your free time?
Robert
Well, I love sport. I’m training to do a triathlon at the
moment, so I’m running, swimming, and cycling every
day. I love bikes, and swimming is great, but, well,
running isn’t fun. I don’t like it much. I also like playing
football and tennis.
Emma
Yes. And golf. You’re always watching golf on TV.
Robert
That’s true. I love the sport, but only on TV. I never play
it.
Emma
Do you like reading?
Robert
Er … Yeah. I enjoy reading newspapers on a Sunday
morning. It’s very relaxing.
Emma
OK. But when did you last read a book?
Robert
A book? Er … well, I read one last week, actually. But, to
be honest, I don’t like reading books. And I don’t like
magazines. I prefer watching films.
Emma
But you hated the film we went to last Friday.
Robert
I know. But that was a romantic film. I love adventure
films or horror film. I don’t like films where people fall in
love. Yuk. That’s for girls.
Emma
OK. Anything else? What do you like doing in the
evenings?
Robert
Er … eating out. Yeah. I love going to restaurants,
especially Italian ones.
Emma
Really? Why’s that?
Robert
Well, I hate shopping. And cooking. And washing up. So,
it’s the only way I get any food to eat!
File 7
Listening 2
1
Joe
Excuse me. Is there a chemist’s near here?
Jane
Er … yes. Go straight on, turn left, then it’s on the right
between the bank and the café.
Joe
Great. Thank you very much.
2
Ruth
What are you going to do next weekend, Simon?
Simon
Oh, there’s a good film on at the Phoenix on Saturday
evening. Dorian Gray. So, I’m going to see it with Tim.
Ruth
Oh, right. I know it. I read the book. It was very good.
3
Peter
Why are you going to take the train?
Jo
Well, I know it’s slow – and expensive. But it’s because my
husband Bill doesn’t like planes, you see. It’s terrible. He
arrives at the airport, and he feels ill. And that’s before we
get on the plane. He hates it. So we can’t fly. Anyway, I like
trains.
Peter
Me too.
4
Sandy
I’m late for work. Where’s my umbrella?
Rick
But it’s going to be hot and sunny today, Sandy. Why do
you want your umbrella?
Sandy
Hot and sunny? I don’t believe it. Yesterday, I didn’t take
my umbrella and it rained. So, I’m going to take it today.
Ah, there it is. OK. Bye.
5
Jason
Where’s David?
Rose
Oh, he’s in the town centre. He’s going to buy some
clothes – new shoes, new shirts, that kind of thing.
Jason
When do you think he’ll be home?
Rose
Oh, not for hours and hours. When he goes to the shops,
he has a great time. He loves buying things.
